description: Rust keeps parked broadcast receivers' wakers in an Arena and wakes them in slot order (broadcast.rs:200, util/arena.rs:530-589). t.1 and t.3 park at 0 (slots 0 and 1); the driver cancels t.1 at 100, freeing slot 0, which t.2 then takes when it parks after its sleep. The last sender's drop at 300 wakes slot 0 (t.2) before slot 1 (t.3), although t.3 parked first. Minimized from fuzz case gen-622-10 (twin_run minimize, bd-9kll.5.6).
